posts.text: What a great day for our country. 🇺🇸🚀

Artemis II is officially on the way to the Moon with three great Americans and one great Canadian.

Video
Chag Sameach, Arizona! To all those celebrating in Arizona and around the world, @GabbyGiffords and I send our best wishes. We hope you have a meaningful Seder with family and friends.

When I look up at that rocket and the four astronauts sitting on top of it, I see America at its very best. Our country is deeply divided and we have real challenges. But I'd encourage everyone to watch this launch today and be proud of our country and what we're capable of when we work together.


NASA (@NASA)

The hatch is now closed.

The Artemis II astronauts are now strapped into their seats and ready for launch.

Artemis II is proof that only in the United States of America can we aim for the stars and actually reach them. Efforts like these push technology and our country forward, together.

While the rich buy more speedboats and mansions, working Americans are struggling to pay the bills. It’s time to refocus our government on what really matters: Lowering the costs of gas, groceries, housing and everything else that’s making it hard for working families to get ahead.

The federal government doesn’t get to tell Arizona how to run its elections. 

Vote by mail in Arizona is secure. Voters from every corner of the state and every political viewpoint have used it for decades to elect Republicans and Democrats. 

I’ll support @AGKrisMayes and @AZSecretary with anything they need to fight this and protect Arizona voters.

Today on Trans Day of Visibility, we celebrate the trans community and honor their resilience and courage.  
   
Transgender Americans deserve to live freely and safely. That hasn't changed, and neither has our commitment to fighting for it.

Health care should be affordable and accessible for every family. But Trump and Republicans slashed Medicaid and allowed health care premiums to skyrocket — all to pay for tax cuts for rich people. We should be lowering costs and expanding coverage, not making it harder for people to get care.

The cost of living is sky high. Let’s call it what it is: an emergency. But Washington isn’t treating it like one.

That’s why @RepDeluzio and I are introducing legislation to force action and put working Americans first.

Today, we honor the Americans who served in Vietnam and recognize the courage and sacrifice that service demanded. Brave men and women from across the country served with courage, and many gave their lives. We can never repay them for their sacrifice.
There’s a real cost to a shutdown, and that’s why we’ve been working hard to end it and passed this bill Thursday night. It’s time for House Republicans and Donald Trump to do the same.
